text:
The plate looks like a dinner plate of about 26 cm, though the photo is taken at an angle.

The food is two rib sections, each roughly 18-20 cm long and 3-4 cm wide. They look like trimmed spare ribs, or possibly riblets, with bones. Each section probably weighs about 100-120 g with bone, so the two together are about 220 g. The edible meat is about 60% of that, around 130 g. Glazed ribs run roughly 250-300 kcal per 100 g of edible portion, which gives about 350 kcal.

There are also 4 baby carrots at about 10 g each, so 40 g and about 15 kcal.

Total mass is about 260 g and total energy is about 370 kcal.
